'# dataset = pandas.DataFrame(JobLevel, Annual Salary)
# dataset = dataset.drop_duplicates()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = dataset.copy()
level_order = sorted(df[''JobLevel''].unique(), key=lambda x: int(x[1:]))
data = [df.loc[df[''JobLevel''] == lvl, ''Salary''].dropna() for lvl in level_order]

bg, fg, mute = ''#FFFFFF'', ''#1F2A37'', ''#595959''
box_color, mean_color = ''#2E75B6'', ''#ED7D31''

plt.rcParams[''font.family''] = ''Calibri''
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5), dpi=120)
fig.patch.set_facecolor(bg)
ax.set_facecolor(bg)

bp = ax.boxplot(
    data,
    tick_labels=level_order,
    showmeans=True,
    meanprops=dict(marker=''D'', markerfacecolor=mean_color, markeredgecolor=mean_color, markersize=6),
    medianprops=dict(color=fg, linewidth=2),
    boxprops=dict(color=box_color, linewidth=1.5),
    whiskerprops=dict(color=mute),
    capprops=dict(color=mute),
    flierprops=dict(marker=''o'', markerfacecolor=mute, markeredgecolor=''none'', markersize=4, alpha=0.5),
    patch_artist=True
)
for patch in bp[''boxes'']:
    patch.set_facecolor(''#E8F0F9'')

ax.set_title(''Salary Distribution by Job Level'', fontsize=14, color=fg, pad=12)
ax.set_xlabel(''Job Level'', fontsize=12, color=mute, labelpad=8)
ax.set_ylabel(''Annual Salary (£)'', fontsize=12, color=mute, labelpad=8)
ax.tick_params(colors=mute, labelsize=11)
for spine in [''top'', ''right'']:
    ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)
for spine in [''left'', ''bottom'']:
    ax.spines[spine].set_color(mute)

# format y-axis ticks as £ with thousands separators
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda v, pos: f"£{v:,.0f}")

# --- one consolidated label per box (above the top whisker) instead of
#     four separate floating numbers that collide on tight ranges ---
y_top = max(s.max() for s in data if not s.empty)
headroom = y_top * 0.14  # reserve space above the tallest whisker for labels

for i, series in enumerate(data, start=1):
    if series.empty:
        continue
    vmin, vmax = series.min(), series.max()
    vmed = series.median()
    vmean = series.mean()

    label = (f"Max  £{vmax:,.0f}\n"
             f"Med  £{vmed:,.0f}\n"
             f"Avg  £{vmean:,.0f}\n"
             f"Min  £{vmin:,.0f}")

    ax.annotate(label, (i, vmax), xytext=(0, 10), textcoords=''offset points'',
                fontsize=11, color=fg, ha=''center'', va=''bottom'', linespacing=1.6,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle=''round,pad=0.35'', facecolor=''#F5F7F9'', edgecolor=mute, linewidth=0.6))

ax.set_ylim(top=y_top + headroom)

ax.plot([], [], color=fg, linewidth=2, label=''Median'')
ax.plot([], [], marker=''D'', color=mean_color, linestyle=''None'', markersize=6, label=''Mean'')
ax.plot([], [], color=mute, linewidth=1, label=''Min / Max'')
ax.legend(loc=''upper left'', frameon=False, fontsize=11, labelcolor=mute)
ax.margins(x=0.06)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
